policy_sampling_rng: Restore each fixed parent final checkpoint CPU/CUDA RNG after construction
boundary: Fresh native episodes and zero recurrent/goal states; parent v1 has no live runtime snapshot
optimizer: Restore complete parent RMSProp state and learning rate; no new warmup
objective: Unchanged original reward-only navigation A2C; all weights trainable
model_selection: Fixed final parent only; retain all five block endpoints; no adaptive selection
interpretation: One preselected training-seed pair; extension declared after pilot endpoint
budget: Two T4 workers, two-hour DELETE each; 5.625 USD reservation in original cumulative 500 USD
literature: https://arxiv.org/html/2408.00109v2 section6: state-noise robustness motivates attraction; their task and noise scale differ

noise.distribution: Independent zero-mean Gaussian per coordinate and update
noise.timing: After the LSTM computes(h,c), before actor and critic; active only when VisualClock.mask is true
noise.replay: Store each sampled h/c noise vector and reuse it exactly through BPTT; independent bootstrap draw; noise has no gradients
noise.sampling: Dedicated RNG; draws do not consume environment, clock or action generators; full RNG saved for exact resume
noise.units: Same absolute0.02 in both h and c, not equal relative disturbance because their amplitudes differ. No outcome-based tuning.

comparator: Frozen noiseless v2 continuation from exactly the same two v1 final policies and RMSProp states, with the same task, learning frames and fresh-episode seeds
extra_evaluation: Matched noisy6-branch navigation before training and at the fixed final endpoint; clean evaluation before and at every fixed block as in v2
hypotheses: Whether generic reward-trained noise robustness produces selective recovery and a persistent circular state, and whether PGC removal/restoration changes it. No ring, angular target, angle loss, decoder or controller is added.
